senses.gloss: m. (a corruption of ἡμισάβανον) a half-size sabanum, linen cloth.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 59a:17">Gitt. 59ᵃ</cite> (sent to Rabbi) <he>סובני וח׳ סובני וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>סיבני וח׳</he> only) a full-size sabanum and a half-size, which were compressed to the respective sizes of a nut and half a nut.
